plot_sweep_results: plot performance curves from vLLM parameter sweep results in a directory
create_figure_grid: create a grid of performance figures grouped by row, column, and curve variables
filter_sweep_data: filter sweep data by comparison operators like less than or greater than or equal to
bin_sweep_variables: bin sweep variables by a specified size to avoid plotting too-close points
dry_run_plot_grid: dry run the plot command to preview figure layout without generating images
